يختبزون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَبِزُونَ (yaḵtabizūna) /jax.ta.bi.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
# يُخْتَبَزُونَ (yuḵtabazūna) /jux.ta.ba.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
